newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE TURNOVER AND PRICES UP IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE TURNOVER AND PRICES UP IN APRIL.

text.p: Tallinn stock exchange turnover was 221.6 million kroons higher at 1.478 billion kroons in April compared to March and the Talse index gained by 4.85 points or 1.89 percent.

The index gained 1.89 percent to close at 261.39 points and trade in main and secondary list shares accounted for 86.12 percent and trading in free market shares 13.24 percent of the total turnover, the bourse said in its monthly statement.

Hansapank shares were the most traded with the turnover of 342 million kroons or 23 percent of total turnover. Hansapank ended the month 46.9 percent lower but it doubled its share captal during April. This is also the reason that Pennu lost 45 percent.
On the main list, Forekspank gained the most or 7.77 percent to close at 190.75 kroons.
On the free market, Kalev rose by 28.3 percent to close at 1700 kroons.
Uhispank lost 8.85 percent to 51.5 kroons while Saku on the free market lost 7.45 percent to 43.5 kroons.
